tasks.title: Ready to do the ASC steps? Everything else is already done.
tasks.description:
🔴 #26 · Ship 1.0 — the last steps are yours, in App Store Connect

Coral's rec: Yes. Screenshots and a numbered walkthrough are prepared and waiting (that half was never blocked on you — see the misfiling note below); what needs you is uploading them, writing release notes, selecting build 33, and pressing Submit. The white-screen bug cannot occur in the native build (verified structurally in `vite.config.ts`), so nothing about it should delay the store. *Misfiling caught 2026-09-01 (cross-pollination brief, "misfiled is not deferred"): this item previously read "say go and I prep everything," which filed MY unblocked screenshot work behind HIS decision. Nothing was waiting on him for that half. Prep now proceeds independently; only the ASC actions — which genuinely require his login — remain his.*
